svg.aria-label: Sketch after an AP photograph carried by NPR: a Tehran street, a sculpted stone fist rising from a stylized feather over a ring of small triangular flags on a plinth, a dark tarpaulin fence strung with round lantern bulbs, a metal wall with rows of small posters, young trees along the sidewalk, apartment and office blocks and a cell tower at left, a streetlamp at right, and three motorcyclists passing in the foreground drawn as silhouettes without faces.
